selectionRule: Choose by surface and placement; preserve aspect ratio and clear space.

variants.note: Arrangement is correct, but the supplied review raster has a faint line above the right tower. Use the dark stacked version for issue until this file is cleaned.

platformNotes.googleBusinessProfile: Use a square full-name or symbol variant; Google recommends 720x720 PNG/JPG and a 250x250 minimum.
platformNotes.googleAds: Use a square variant; Google recommends 1200x1200 and keeping important content in the central 80%.
platformNotes.googlePerformanceMax: Use the horizontal variant inside a correctly sized 4:1 export canvas; do not stretch the supplied 3:1 raster.
platformNotes.googleSearchFavicon: Use a square symbol source and test a dedicated export larger than 48x48; upload/deployment is separate from this asset pack.

restrictions: Do not stretch, rotate, mirror, crop, recolour or place on a noisy background.
These PNGs are opaque and are not transparent overlays.
Do not use a full-name lockup at favicon size; use the symbol where the name would be unreadable.
Large-format fabrication, embroidery, engraving and strict colour workflows require a vector master and supplier proof.
